name: story-weaver
description: See the node under the cursor and play the book from there

commands.title: Story Weaver: Play from the start

storyWeaver.follow.markdownDescription: The panel follows the cursor. Off, it stays on the node it is showing.

storyWeaver.host.markdownDescription: Host values for the playthrough, as `key=value`, comma separated (`steps=2000,elapsed=3600`, say). Without them a book that reads the clock or a counter plays against its fallbacks.

storyWeaver.language.markdownDescription: The language to play in. Empty means the book's own default language.
